profile: SQLite 3.47.2, UTF-8, stock SQLite affinity, index planner and file format, exact bound ordinary table identity.
scope: Native CAST type names and binary IFNULL used in complete index operands and partial predicates.

Expression/CastTypeName.role: The resolved native SQLite type name in a planner-sensitive CAST.
Expression/CastTypeName.structure: Case-sensitive UTF-8 type name bytes as the SQLite token denotes after decoding, independent of the original quoting syntax.
Expression/CastTypeName.conditions: The name contains no zero byte, fits the fixed statement envelope, and determines one effective CAST target through the ordered SQLite affinity rule.
Expression/CastTypeName.meaning: The type name's bytes distinguish SQLite planner matches. The effective type determines conversion of the operand including NULL.
Expression/CastTypeName.externalInterpretation: Use SQLite 3.47.2 and its native byte-exact type-name matching when a query forces a partial index.
Expression/CastTypeName.sql: Write this semantic type name as one double-quoted type identifier, doubling embedded delimiters, and account for its UTF-8 payload.

Expression/CastExpression.role: Convert an operand with the checked native CAST target and optional planner-sensitive native type name.
Expression/CastExpression.structure: Effective closed CastTarget, resolved scalar operand, and optional immutable CastTypeName.
Expression/CastExpression.conditions: If a native type name is given its derived target equals the effective target. The enclosing expression scope checks the child and combined payload.
Expression/CastExpression.meaning: Convert as the effective target requests, preserving NULL and the given native planner name when it is part of the role.
Expression/CastExpression.externalInterpretation: The token spelling was resolved before construction. Interpret its exact native type name in SQLite index matching.
Expression/CastExpression.sql: Emit CAST with checked operand, effective canonical name when the type name is absent, or the safely quoted exact semantic type name.

Expression/Nulls/Coalesce.role: Evaluate the first non-NULL input, with an explicit native binary IFNULL selection when planner matching requires it.
Expression/Nulls/Coalesce.structure: An immutable ordered argument list and a Boolean selecting the binary native IFNULL spelling.
Expression/Nulls/Coalesce.conditions: COALESCE has two through 127 arguments. IFNULL has exactly two. Every argument remains a checked scalar under its enclosing ordinal scope.
Expression/Nulls/Coalesce.meaning: Evaluate ordered inputs until the first non-NULL. Preserve the specified builtin identity for SQLite index planner matching.
Expression/Nulls/Coalesce.externalInterpretation: Use the pinned builtin meanings and exact context-appropriate native planner selection.
Expression/Nulls/Coalesce.sql: Write IFNULL or COALESCE as selected by the value and emit the ordered arguments.

rules: SQLite uses the exact decoded CAST name in expression matching, including letter case, spanning trivia and numeric modifiers when unquoted. A leading delimited token uses its decoded name and discards following tokens. An empty native name has NUMERIC conversion.

Independently observed canonical quoted type-name emission preserves the native planner identity across these forms. Capture only the semantic type name in a completed value. Lowering may inspect parsed tokens before constructing it.

Choose the effective cast target using the native priority INT, then CHAR/CLOB/TEXT, then BLOB, then REAL/FLOA/DOUB, then NUMERIC. Embedded trivia can contribute to a native type token and its conversion. A name is never SQL code.
IFNULL and COALESCE share the first-non-NULL rule but differ in native index matching. A binary explicitly retained IFNULL operation emits IFNULL. Other callers may use the common COALESCE role.
Admit supported forms through the same direct and analyzed CreateIndex routes and retain all previous index coverage, forced-index and fault checks.
